ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the Cci-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-G

in the area bound by:

West 92" Place; South Vincennes Avenue; West 93” Street; a line 270 feet east of and
parallel to South Aberdeen Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West 93” Street;
and the alley next east of and parallel to South Aberdeen Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

ent So

Ronnie L. Mosley J
Alderman, 215* Ward

Common Address:
9232-9246 S. Vincennes Avenue
1032 W. 93" Street
